items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Man said, please, you listen to Bunny Berrigan. Can't get started.

ctx.x: I guess he's really the father of all of you, isn't he? Father of the world.
Man said, please, you listen to Bunny Berrigan. Can't get started. Uh huh. What is it?
Louis and A? Uh huh. You really see him in all the music that's come, come since him.
